newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Imperial Credit EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Imperial Credit EPS raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said it raised its fiscal year 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates for Imerial Credit Mortgage Holdings Inc by $0.10 each, to $1.90 and $2.35, respectively.
-- In a report dated September 20, EVEREN analysts also said they raised the price objectives for the medium term to $22 from $20 and to $25 from $24 for the long term.
